base_label_noise_hindsight_model_alone_a.description: Model-alone opener picks from the hindsight-label ridge v the served base ridge.
base_label_noise_hindsight_model_alone_a.notes: Base ridge alpha 10, 88 inputs, trained on hindsight gap label (same-season leave-own-game-out team-rating margin minus closing line) for seasons before the test season; test-season in-week rows keep the real label. Graded at the Tuesday opener 2020-25, 1503 served games (pushes excluded by the served fitter), served four-term logistic refit leave-one-season-out.
